summary: Master the fundamentals of macroeconomics! Explore GDP, inflation, and monetary policy in our training designed for aspiring economists and professionals.
lede: Macroeconomic fundamentals describe economy-wide forces such as output, employment, inflation, and monetary policy. For professionals using economic data in finance or strategy, this course develops practical ways to assess business-cycle phases, measure and decompose GDP, interpret inflation and central bank policy, and build macroeconomic scenarios to inform organizational planning.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who engage with economic data, policy signals, or macroeconomic conditions as part of their day-to-day responsibilities — whether they are building financial models, advising on strategy, managing portfolios, or shaping organizational plans. It suits both those new to formal macroeconomic frameworks and those with practical exposure who want a structured, analytically rigorous foundation.
audience: Central Bank and Regulatory Affairs Professionals
Graduate Economists and Early-Career Finance Professionals
modules: Aggregate Demand, Aggregate Supply, and Equilibrium
Monetary Policy: Tools, Frameworks, and Transmission
The IS-LM Model and Fiscal-Monetary Interactions
Open-Economy Macroeconomics and Exchange Rate Dynamics
Macroeconomic Scenario Analysis and Economic Outlook Reporting
prerequisites: This course is designed for professionals at the foundation-to-intermediate level. No prior formal training in economics is required, though familiarity with basic financial concepts — such as interest rates, inflation headlines, and GDP growth figures — will help you engage with the material from day one. You should be comfortable reading tables and charts and working with numerical data at a non-technical level. No econometrics, coding, or statistical software is required. Participants are encouraged to bring a laptop to access publicly available central bank data portals and national accounts databases used in the applied exercises.
